messages:
Maya: Heads-up — EU cloud partner reports increased tail latency after we updated marketplace node image from ROCm 5.4 -> 5.6 last night. They see p99 spikes and some request queuing.
Ethan: Can you share the exact image tag and node kernel/driver versions? We'll triage memory/IO pressure first.
Maya: Image: `redwood/llm-runtime:rocm-5.6-2026-03-21-eu`, kernel 5.15.90-rt, amdgpu 6.1.1. Repro: `make bench RUN=serve_bench BATCH=4 SEQ=1024` — no OOMs, just p99 spikes to ~900ms.
Diego: Quick checklist: (1) check amdgpu module parameters (prefetch, large-paged), (2) verify ROCm hipBLAS is not falling back, (3) confirm udev firmware blobs loaded.
infra-bot: Telemetry alert: node eu-3 showed KV cache eviction bursts at 02:13UTC. Metric: kv_evictions/sec = 12 -> 48 for 2 minutes.
Maya: Partner gave traces: `kv_evict: reason=pressure evicted=18` and host logs show `mm_cgroup: memory_event: high`.
Ethan: Might be a kernel tunable interacting badly with ROCm 5.6 memory allocator. Diego, can you run `sysctl -a | grep vm` and post relevant ones?
Diego: Posted snippet: `vm.swappiness=10`, `vm.dirty_ratio=20`, `vm.max_map_count=262144`. Nothing crazy. Also `cat /sys/module/amdgpu/parameters/prefetch` -> `1`.
Zoe: From product: partner asks for recommended action — rollback listing or keep and patch? They want a 6-12 hour ETA.
Diego: Short mitigation we can try: build a `rocm-5.6-compat` image that forces `amdgpu.prefetch=0` and enables hugepages. That avoids changing customer app while altering kernel module params. We can do image-level modprobe.d + sysctl on boot.
Maya: Good plan. Partner prefers non-invasive image change. If that doesn't resolve, fallback to marketplace listing rollback.
Ethan: I'll run a canary with `rocm-5.6-compat` on our EU staging nodes. Command: `k run bench --image redwood/llm-runtime:rocm-5.6-compat --replicas 3 --bench serve_bench --args "--batch 4 --seq 1024"`.
infra-bot: CI job `marketplace-smoke (rocm-5.6-compat)` queued.
```
Bench results (staging): p50=38ms p95=150ms p99=220ms (improved vs partner repro)
```
Diego: Flamegraph show spike in `memcpy_async` during p99; switching prefetch=0 reduced copy stalls. Also verified hipBLAS still on device.
vendor-bot: FYI vendor kernel team confirmed a change in 6.x kernels that affects amdgpu prefetch heuristics; they suggested a driver-side fix but estimate 2-3 weeks for stable rollout.
Maya: So immediate path: (A) publish `rocm-5.6-compat` image to marketplace and update listing with “temporary module param to mitigate latency” + run 24h canary; (B) if partner still sees spikes, rollback to `rocm-5.4-stable`.
Zoe: I'll draft partner comms: explain mitigations, ETA for canary results (~6h), and long-term: vendor hotfix timeline.
Ethan: I'll post detailed repro + perf artifacts in the ticket: flamegraph, perf trace, kernel param diff.
Maya: Thanks team. Assign actions: Diego build image + config (ETA 2h), Ethan run canary & collect traces (ETA 3h), Zoe partner comms (ETA 1h). Will reconvene in #partnerships in 3h or sooner if infra-bot flags regression. :white_check_mark:
